title: derive_subkey cross-stack identity vector parity (Rust nostr-bbs-core <-> agentbox JavaScript)

construction.algorithm: HMAC-SHA-256(key = root secret key, 32 raw bytes; message = UTF-8 bytes of tag) -> 32-byte child secret key, then validated as a secp256k1 scalar (0 < x < n)
construction.note: Deliberately NOT HKDF. Do not "upgrade" this construction — it exists to match the agentbox JavaScript derivation byte-for-byte. See ADR-2003 / ADR-094.

edge_cases_covered: canonical tags in live use by both stacks (agentbox-mirror-v1, agentbox-gateway-v1, agentbox-agent-v1)
tag rotation -v1 -> -v2 for both the mirror and gateway tags (same root, distinct child)
long tag (519 UTF-8 bytes, past the SHA-256 block size)
non-ASCII UTF-8 tag spanning 2-, 3- and 4-byte sequences (cafe with acute, CJK, emoji)
tag with a combining acute accent (byte-level, no NFC normalisation on either side)
tag with significant leading/trailing whitespace (no trimming on either side)
root separation (same tag under two different roots)
invalid roots: all-zero, all-0xff, and exactly the curve order n

js_provenance.reason: None of the three agentbox call sites export the derivation. config/hooks/nostr-live-mirror.cjs exports only composeBody, mintActivityUrn, activityScopePubkey, bodyForEvent and MAX_BODY_CHARS - deriveChildKey is module-private. config/nostr-gateway/nostr-send.cjs and config/nostr-gateway/gateway.cjs are self-executing entrypoints (process.exit / socket bind at require time) and additionally require nostr-tools, which this repository does not depend on. The parity runner therefore re-executes the identical construction verbatim and pins the agentbox sources by sha256 plus an exact-expression check, so a change to the agentbox derivation fails the runner instead of passing against a stale mirror.

preserved.note: Retained unchanged per ADR-2003; the fixture vector 'canonical-mirror-v1' reproduces its known answer (2d07f2ce93d0361687fdd81d2690082b5d6c35b93e3ece2d44bcf115ef8f695d).

cases: corrupted expected_child_secret_hex in the fixture -> rust test FAILED (1 of 5), node runner exit 1
fixture file removed -> rust test panicked loudly (no skip), node runner exit 1 with an explicit error
